tool_args.rationale: The fixed-gradient observations show a saturating dependence on u_now, while the inexpensive open-branch probe establishes a strong gradient-dependent transfer effect. Fit a compact saturating response with gradient-dependent linear and quadratic terms numerically; the available observations support this smooth reduced model without another paid probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Seven observations now span the open-branch gradient response as well as the saturation curve; the remaining probe is comparatively costly and is not necessary to fit a low-dimensional smooth law.
It cannot explain the strong change between the two open-branch rows at different s_grad.
It conflicts with the clear saturation across the five fixed-gradient observations.
